source_case: Case4 unchanged estimated native T1 envelope; known inferior/cerebellar exclusions; no whole-brain or pial truth
geometry_operations: None; same source reference and parametrized discrete workflow; only size field differs.

size_profile.meaning: Untested sizing requests; sampled Distance is not the independent surface-error oracle.

eligibility.meaning: Prospective mesh-count gate only; not solver admission or clinical acceptance.

diagnostic_limits.scope: Returned-candidate packet only: four complete NPY arrays plus manifest; excludes previously retained native source surface, bounded result/log receipts and original v1 evidence.

surface_fidelity.meaning: Engineering approximation against the estimated mask isosurface, not anatomical error. Bidirectional nearest-triangle samples plus full triangle-interior covering radius.

solver_admission.limitation: Above3GiB before other allocations; mesh-count acceptance does not permit a Skyline or other patient solve.

execution_release.required: A separately reviewed source-bound launcher must verify source/runtime/case hashes, enforce one fresh attempt and supervisor caps. This helper has no image reader, CLI, runtime initialization or solver.

prohibited: new patient arrays before root release
